correctness.rationale: Read complete frozen proof, assumptions, and check.py. Direct block multiplication independently gave per-mode characteristic z[z²-(1-c²/q)z+b_i²/q]. For largest B the root product implies q>=B²/r²; for smallest beta the real quadratic at r is nonnegative and implies q r(1-r)<=c²r+beta², hence r>=r* for r<1. At q*=B²/r*², sum r*(1+beta²/B²) and products in [r*² beta²/B²,r*²] put every real or conjugate mode within radius r*, with equality at both extremes. Equality in the two necessary inequalities gives q=q*. Independently computed exact eigenvalues for beta=1,B=3,c=4: radii 1/2 at q=36 and 3/5 at q=25. Repeated-root beta=B case and finite dimension root-limit are explicitly accounted for; numerical sample checks are not the proof.
